test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

If I was a clown, I would have made everyone smile.
solution:
The correct answer is "**If I was a clown.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The correct verb to use in this sentence is "were" instead of "was" because it is in the subjunctive mood.**
 
• Subjunctive mood is used to express hypothetical or unreal situations.
 
• In this case, the speaker is not actually a clown so the subjunctive mood should be used.
 
• The correct sentence would be:
 
 
• "If I were a clown, I would have made everyone smile." 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
